name: Rejected Status Reason 14 Code
definition: Specifies the reason for a rejected status.

NSLA.name: Not Compliant With SLA
NSLA.definition: Instruction is not compliant with the service level agreement.

CUTO.name: Cut Off Time
CUTO.definition: Instruction has been received after the cut-off time.

NALC.name: Not Allowed To Cancel
NALC.definition: Instructing party is not allowed to request a cancellation.

ADEA.name: After Deadline
ADEA.definition: Instruction was received after the Receiver's deadline.

NRGM.name: No Cancellation Match
NRGM.definition: The cancellation request has been rejected since more than one instruction match to the cancellation criteria.
